title: Police | Hallandale Beach
column7: The city presents Hallandale Beach Police Department as the current municipal police agency and links to Crime Statistics, UCR Reports, and FBI NIBIRS Data from the police page.

title: Staff Directory • Police Department
key_finding: The Police Department is listed as a 24-hour city department with Chief Michel Michel, Deputy Chief Terence Thouez, and multiple captains.

title: Staff Directory
key_finding: The city directory separately lists Fire Rescue - BSO Hallandale Beach and Police Department, showing BSO's city role is fire rescue rather than primary policing.

title: November 2024 Monthly Crime Incidents
key_finding: The city publicly released a 2024 Hallandale Beach Police Department monthly incident report with HDPD case-level offenses in Hallandale Beach.

title: ATMS agency registry search surface
key_finding: FDLE's official agency registry lists Hallandale Beach Police Department with ORI FL0060400.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal offense report lists Hallandale Beach Police Department with population 39,945 and total index crime 1,247.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
key_finding: FDLE's 2021 county-and-municipal offense report retains Hallandale Beach Police Department as a Broward municipal row with population 41,157 but all offense fields blank.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q2 workbook
key_finding: Inspection of the official FDLE FIBRS offense workbook found no Hallandale Beach Police Department row in the 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 Q2 sheets.

title: agency_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.parquet
key_finding: The live crosswalk routes FL0060400 exclusively to Hallandale Beach city.

title: agency_master.parquet
key_finding: FL0060400 is classified as a local police department and is flagged with SRS and NIBRS source presence through 2024.

title: agency_year_observations.parquet
key_finding: Repo observations show Hallandale Beach annual Part I totals of 1,513 in 2018, 1,422 in 2019, and 1,247 in 2020, followed by zero annual totals in 2021-2024.

title: jurisdiction_controls_2024.parquet
key_finding: All 2024 Hallandale Beach offense controls are fully fill-backed because preferred reported support is zero and the row is treated as structurally missing or unreliable.

title: municipal_target_review_queue.parquet
key_finding: Hallandale Beach is queued in high_impact_full_fill_place with total_fill_count 1,489.0, total_reported_count 0.0, and priority_rank 1.

title: fbi_cde_source_review_queue.csv
key_finding: The FBI CDE review queue flags FL0060400 as present_but_no_2024_observation and official_is_nibrs false, consistent with a public continuity gap rather than a sheriff-replacement routing issue.

title: Crime Statistics document center index
key_finding: The city's document center index exposes the full twelve-PDF 2024 Monthly Crime Incidents roster used to build the packet-local annual offense extract.

title: UCR Summary Reporting Guide Manual
key_finding: FDLE UCR offense definitions explicitly classify burglary to a conveyance as larceny theft from motor vehicle and treat Florida aggravated battery within aggravated assault reporting, which supports the Hallandale annual comparator mapping.
